component.name: Elemental
component.summary: Light windows, a see-through top bar, a light dock

description.p: A light style for the FlickOS desktop: windows in one light grey with the title in the middle and plain buttons, a see-through dark top bar with white text, a dark slate terminal and a seashore seen from above.

It comes with a layout of the same name: a thin top bar with Applications on the left and the date and time in the middle, a light dock at the bottom, and the close button on the left of the title bar and maximize on the right. Use sets both; you can still pick another layout in Settings.
